The Model Y L has a little row of icons on the right side of the climate screen so the front passenger can more quickly jump to whatever row they want to control.

Video

More details about the Model Y L, graciously shared by @SawyerMerritt.

Despite recent rumors we’ve seen posted by certain accounts and publications, the new wireless phone charger won’t be coming to the United States just yet.


Sawyer Merritt (@SawyerMerritt)

Can confirm that the Model Y L does come with PowerShare in North America (V2H), 11.5kW output to your home. Sounds like it will require Powerwall 3.

As for the actively cooled wireless phone chargers, North American Model Y L doesn't come with it right now. Tesla said this is because North America hasn't adopted the new Qi charging standard yet, and that China has much faster wirelessly charging phones right now. They will add it to the Model Y L (and other Tesla vehicle models) in North America in the next 1-2 years.







— https://nitter.net/SawyerMerritt/status/2082981637751799977#m
